scope: Focused pinned function definitions and Rust capability mapping; no new source-unit approvals.
mapping: U2F ISO reader returns copied prefix plus the actual certificate count and stops before the signature on a short read.
apdu_output rejects negative/excessive counts or zero total progress, advances by the actual count, and closes on error/completion.
Native HID APDU source requires an exact requested read; Rust Response::read remains exact even for registration.
Storage::read_some_at defaults to exact read_at and preserves counts in CIU/native adapters with an explicit output bound. Existing read_at callers retain exact-or-error semantics.
remaining: Actual native-backend fault injection, USB U2F polling and physical/resource acceptance are not established.
